digest.component_or_area: LLM framework code review trigger system
propositions: The rebar project experiences trigger over-fire (35.3% of diffs) when both committed high-precision tier (13.3%) and noisy-tier vocabulary (22% additional) are active; three corpus bugs trigger only through noisy-tier tokens, making that tier load-bearing for this repo
Project-level trigger vocabulary extensions lack documentation, preventing other projects from copying the two-layer design pattern
A `concurrency` overlay entry must be added to this repo's `.rebar/criteria_routing.json` with project-specific tokens and glob patterns to demonstrate the two-layer trigger mechanism

The project entry's effect on trigger behavior must be verifiable through integration testing: a diff containing `index.lock` fires the overlay under effective routing but not under committed-only routing

The two-layer trigger design (committed high-precision tier plus project noisy tier), the measured fire-rate tradeoff, and the vocabulary-addition mechanism must be documented in `docs/llm-framework.md` with this repo as the worked example
